content.text:
I've fixed all three CI failures. They passed on this machine only because of my local settings and a slower processor, and I reproduced each one before fixing it. All 499 tests now pass with no warnings, and a Windows type-check is clean.

**The two brightness tests:** the tests were reading the real saved theme choice from the config folder. Mine says "dark", so they passed here. A CI runner has no saved choice, so the window switched to the system's appearance (light) mid-test, and the slider thumb and reset button landed on light mode. Tests now never read the saved theme choice and never follow the system's appearance; each test sets its own mode. The fix is in `src/theme_preference.rs`.

**`long_output_is_measured_a_few_rows_a_frame`:** this one was a real bug in the app, not just the test. Rows out of view were measured within a 4 ms time limit per frame, with no limit on how many. On a fast machine, one frame could measure every row of a long output, which the spec rules out ("without any one frame laying out every row"). I added a cap of 32 rows per frame alongside the time limit in `src/measured_list.rs`. To check it, I raised the time limit to 4 seconds to mimic a fast runner: the test failed without the cap and passes with it.

**One more test** (`the_theme_editor_opens_in_the_inset_panel`) had quietly relied on the saved theme choice too, and failed once tests stopped reading it. It now sets dark mode itself, like the other theme tests.

**The two brightness tests:** the tests were reading the real saved theme choice from the config folder. Mine says "dark", so they passed here. A CI runner has no saved choice, so the window switched to the system's appearance (light) mid-test, and the slider thumb and reset button landed on light mode. Tests now never read the saved theme choice and never follow the system's appearance; each test sets its own mode. The fix is in `src/theme_preference.rs`.

**`long_output_is_measured_a_few_rows_a_frame`:** this one was a real bug in the app, not just the test. Rows out of view were measured within a 4 ms time limit per frame, with no limit on how many. On a fast machine, one frame could measure every row of a long output, which the spec rules out ("without any one frame laying out every row"). I added a cap of 32 rows per frame alongside the time limit in `src/measured_list.rs`. To check it, I raised the time limit to 4 seconds to mimic a fast runner: the test failed without the cap and passes with it.

**One more test** (`the_theme_editor_opens_in_the_inset_panel`) had quietly relied on the saved theme choice too, and failed once tests stopped reading it. It now sets dark mode itself, like the other theme tests.
